title: boardwise symbol library sample — one differential case input
description: A declared sample of .epru record text plus the key its pins are addressed by. The input carries no expected projection: both runners derive boardwise.symbol-library/1 from the text.

text.x-meaning: The .epru record stream verbatim: {envelope}||{body}| lines, terminator optional on the last line.

pinKey.x-meaning: How a PIN row is addressed: the synthesised e<zIndex> of a V3 .epro2, or the row's own envelope id (eprj3).
